theme: Three days of working with what you have — building the resourcefulness mindset

days.task: List every resource you currently have for your most important goal: skills, contacts, tools, time, knowledge. Write what you actually have.
Pick one constraint you're facing. Treat it as a design parameter, not a blocker. What can you build within it?
Identify one person who has already solved a problem you're facing. Ask them one specific question today.
